title: Barrowmere's mound-warden and the Hollowbrook/Fallows factions never referenced the outcome of 'Whose Ground' once it was decided — Surveyor Pell's and Recruiter Dace's remaining quests resolved through unrelated might-checks/free actions with no dialogue acknowledging the land had already been formally awarded to the returners.
